posts.author: Ghonarbochon
posts.text: I think Piccadily was having this same issue for last two years and is ahead in the curve at the moment. The news of UK FTA implementation and resultant reduction of foreign whisky prices by 10-15% in some states is what has caused the stock to correct from 760 to 570 levels in past month or so ..so clearly the market is cautious about the effects.However, premium single malt whisky is a matter of taste and people may not switch brands for a 10% savings .Price reduction of foreign single malt may increase some sales overall and actually benefit all companies by expanding the target customer ba…

posts.author: Midhunjoe
posts.text: Amrut facing the double whammy of inventory shortage and pricing competition due to UK FTA . Hence planning to expand to Blended Whisky and gin, vodka, rum and Tequila. Piccadilly could have similar scenario. Despite the bullish commentary market would be nonchalant due to these reasons.
